assets.access_note: Official guidance requires logged-in online request/download; restricted data may require an official letter and in-person receipt.
assets.required_processing: Select study-area tiles and closest documented production year; record license/classification codes; rasterize to the common 30 m grid; apply config/fuel_scores.csv.
Preserve station ID, timestamp basis, QC flags, and missing-data treatment. Interpolate using a documented event window and method.

assets.access_note: ASOS file-set catalog verifies long-period coverage, but station/element availability, account access, and usage conditions must be checked at download.
assets.required_processing: Record element-specific coverage, station history, quality controls, aggregation and climatology formula.
Reproject to EPSG:5186 and rasterize to common grids only after validation. A reconstructed news-based polygon is prohibited for definitive validation.
All GeoTIFFs must be co-registered in EPSG:5186 at 30 m; factors must be 0–100; burn label must contain both 0 and 1.

assets.verified_access: Official historical current-analysis and forecast ZIP endpoints supplied non-georeferenced PNG maps for 2025-03-25 when checked on 2026-09-18.
assets.limitation: PNG map images lack documented georeferencing and cell values; they must not be treated as quantitative KFFDRS/FWI rasters or used for ROC/AUC.
assets.required_processing: Obtain licensed source grids or reproduce an index using documented input data, then align to the same event period, extent, CRS, and evaluation sample as FVI.
